about: The lead-time line: every warning and decision with a time known to the minute, in order: hours since the previous one, since the first, before the first red warning starts in Lisbon (h_before_red_starts) and before its own effect starts (h_before_effect). For IPMA's colour warnings the time is when IPMA sent the message (CAP). Order, not cause. Built by tools/graph-build.mjs from the incident's JSON; every row carries label, source, read and origin. Not a warning service.

rows.what: "Nombrada la borrasca Charles": a storm of subtropical origin, very adverse rain, wind and sea on Wednesday and, less, Thursday; a special warning to follow
rows.label: fact

Reasons given: tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport, high winds on external structures; after discussions with the government, ANEPC and PSP.

rows.what: Regional president's briefing at SRPC: "479 milímetros de precipitação em 12 horas", more than the 387 mm of 20 February 2010 over the same reference period; hourly peak 65 l/m² at 06:00 against 78 in 2010; most critical period 02:00 to 03:00 (heavy rain with high tide and high stream flows)
